notes.title: 🌟 New Game Mode: Frenzy 🌟 (1.5.0)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748525/8b712c9308d8e1dba7824aff71f40312b86e9cd5.jpg[/img]

🎉 [b]Get Ready for the Frenzy![/b] 🎉
We’re thrilled to unveil our brand-new game mode: Frenzy, now live on Steam!

🌀 [b]What is Frenzy?[/b]
Frenzy is an adrenaline-fueled game mode where you unleash 3 powerful abilities as you score points by merging fruit. It's fun, chaotic, and packed with strategic opportunities.

Here’s what’s waiting for you:

🍉 Shake: Summon a giant watermelon that shakes all the fruit on the board, creating new chances for epic merges.

⚡ Surge: Drop a charged orb that removes all fruit of the same type it collides with. (Hit an apple? Every apple on the board vanishes!)

💥 Smash: Wield a mighty powerup that obliterates every fruit it touches, clearing your path to victory.

🌟 Compete for Glory
A new global leaderboard has been added exclusively for Frenzy mode! Will you rise to the top and prove yourself as the ultimate fruit-merging master? 🍎🍌🍉

Jump into the Frenzy now and show the world your skills! 🍇✨
Update your game and start climbing the leaderboard today!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748525/fddc209ffb6ad86f184aba3559c4da7fc2ea705d.png[/img]
